title: Better Than New — and Priced to Move
description:
Welcome to 803 Wax Myrtle Court A, a nearly new gem tucked in a brand new cul-de-sac in Killeen — where privacy meets polish. At just under two years old, this home has all the charm of new construction with the upgrades already done for you.
Step inside and you'll immediately notice the difference. From the upgraded finishes throughout to the generous cabinet space in the kitchen, every inch of this home was designed with intention. The closets? Upgraded. The living and dining spaces? Move-in ready — already furnished so you can settle in and start living from day one.
Out back, you'll find one of the most sought-after features in any home: no rear neighbors. Just peace, privacy, and room to breathe.
This is the kind of home you have to see in person to truly appreciate — the details tell the story.
Lease: $1,850/month | Partially Furnished (Living & Dining) | Cul-de-Sac Living | Upgraded Throughout
